sex.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice (6-8 weeks old) obtained from Jackson Laboratories

dosing.evidence: ALD-52 was dissolved in isotonic saline and administered by the intraperitoneal (IP) route (5 mL/kg).

handling.evidence: Paper does not mention deliberate handling protocol beyond acclimatization.

group_housing.evidence: housed up to four per cage in a climate-controlled room

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-h reverse-light cycle (lights on at 1900 h, off at 0700 h)

assays.assay_description: Mice with head-mounted magnets were placed in a glass cylinder surrounded by a magnetometer coil. Head twitches were recorded for 30 min immediately after i.p. injection of ALD-52 (0.03-1 mg/kg) or vehicle, with a blockade experiment using M100,907 (0.1 mg/kg s.c.) pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: ALD-52 was dissolved in isotonic saline and administered by the intraperitoneal (IP) route

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper does not describe pre-test apparatus habituation.

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum except during behavioral testing

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum except during behavioral testing

time_to_assay.evidence: Test compounds were injected immediately prior to testing... HTR activity was recorded... for 30 min

sample_size.evidence: Mice (n=5/group, 25 total) were treated with ALD-52... Mice (n = 5/group, 10 total) were pretreated with vehicle or 0.1 mg/kg M100,907

outcomes.summary: ALD-52 produced a dose-dependent increase in head-twitch response counts in male C57BL/6J mice (ED50 = 297.2 nmol/kg), about half the potency of LSD. The effect was abolished by pretreatment with the 5-HT2A antagonist M100,907, confirming 5-HT2A receptor mediation.
outcomes.evidence: ALD-52 induced the HTR when tested in mice (F(4,20) = 16.74, p < 0.0001)... ALD-52 (0.3 mg/kg) did not induce head twitches in mice pretreated with 0.1 mg/kg M100,907 (t(8) = 7.65, p < 0.0001)

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single HTR assay; consolidated as such.

Psychedelic field restricted to ALD-52 since LSD/1P-LSD/1B-LSD HTR data are explicitly cited as previously reported (Halberstadt & Geyer 2013; Brandt et al. 2016, 2019) and not newly collected in this paper.
